meta.license_policy: GPL/AGPL code is quarantined out of the shipped tree per ~/workspace/forge3d/LICENSES.md. Non-commercial (NC) and all-rights-reserved items are flagged research-only. license_verified=true means confirmed against the tool's own source (repo LICENSE file or official terms page) on 2026-10-07.
meta.task: Forge3D catalog part: texture/material + mesh processing tools

section_a_texture_material.name: SwinIR
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API license endpoint (Apache-2.0). Cheaper/faster complement to Real-ESRGAN for texture crispness; CPU-capable. Good first texture-SR wire-up.
section_a_texture_material.what: Swin-Transformer image restoration / super-resolution (classic, lightweight, anime denoise variants). Texture upscale + denoise stage.

section_a_texture_material.name: HAT
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API license endpoint (Apache-2.0). Heavier than SwinIR (more VRAM); best saved for hero-asset texture pass.
section_a_texture_material.what: Hybrid Attention Transformer SR — SOTA PSNR single-image super-resolution. Crisp texture upscaling beyond Real-ESRGAN.

section_a_texture_material.name: Real-CUGAN
section_a_texture_material.notes: Official repo is the bilibili/ailab monorepo; LICENSE file inside Real-CUGAN/ subdir is MIT (fetched raw 2026-10-07). Ideal for the cartoon/stylized AshLane cast textures.
section_a_texture_material.what: Real Cascade U-Nets for anime/cartoon super-resolution (2x/3x/4x + denoise levels). Strong on stylized character textures.

section_a_texture_material.name: GFPGAN
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: LICENSE file text is Apache-2.0 'except for the third-party components listed below' — audit that component list before shipping. Face-specific; pair with a face-crop stage.
section_a_texture_material.what: GAN-based face restoration. Fixes smeared/melted faces on generated character textures.

section_a_texture_material.name: CodeFormer
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: LICENSE file is 'S-Lab License 1.0', redistribution/use for non-commercial purpose only. QUARANTINE from any commercial pipeline; research/experiment use only. Prefer GFPGAN for commercial-safe face fix.
section_a_texture_material.what: Codebook-lookup transformer face restoration, robust on very degraded faces.

section_a_texture_material.name: Paint3D
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (Apache-2.0, org OpenTexture/Paint3D). Directly closes the baked-lighting/speckle texture gap vs Tripo — relightable output fits PBR pipeline. Multi-stage (depth-aware views + UV inpaint + UVHD), GPU-heavy.
section_a_texture_material.what: CVPR 2024 coarse-to-fine diffusion: generates high-res, LIGHTING-LESS 2K UV texture maps (no baked illumination) for untextured meshes, from text or image.

section_a_texture_material.name: TEXTure
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT). Texture EDITING/transfer capability none of the current stack has — enables owner-driven texture tweaks ('make the jacket redder') without full regen.
section_a_texture_material.what: Text-guided iterative depth-diffusion texturing: generate, EDIT, refine, and transfer textures across meshes via trimap multi-view painting.

section_a_texture_material.name: Text2Tex
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: LICENSE file is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0. NON-COMMERCIAL — research only, quarantine from commercial builds. Study its view-selection strategy; implement equivalent under a clean license if needed.
section_a_texture_material.what: Text-to-texture with automatic view selection and progressive inpainting for full 3D coverage.

section_a_texture_material.name: SyncMVD
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT). Built on diffusers — fits the existing Hunyuan3D-Paint/MV-Adapter stack. Closes the multi-view inconsistency gap directly.
section_a_texture_material.what: Synchronized multi-view diffusion texturing: shares denoised content across views per denoising step — seam-free, fragmentation-free textures.

section_a_texture_material.name: MetaTexture
section_a_texture_material.notes: Do NOT wire. Deprioritize; if UV-space texture refinement is wanted, look at Paint3D's UVHD stage or Meta AssetGen paper (closed) instead.
section_a_texture_material.what: NO STANDALONE TOOL FOUND under this name. Closest matches: the 'MetaTexture' UV/gradient technique in the Age-of-Sail NPR paper, and Meta 3D AssetGen's UV-space texture-refinement transformer (no public code).

section_a_texture_material.license: UNVERIFIED — no LICENSE file in repo
section_a_texture_material.name: MaterialGAN
section_a_texture_material.notes: GitHub API license endpoint 404 (no license file). Requires calibrated flash-photo capture rig — high effort, niche payoff. Do not ship without author permission.
section_a_texture_material.what: Generative SVBRDF model: reconstructs PBR material maps from a few flash photographs via optimization.

section_a_texture_material.name: TileGen
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: README License section says 'Copyright (c) 2023, Xilong Zhou. All rights reserved.' No license granted — effectively proprietary. Note concept only; do not clone.
section_a_texture_material.what: Tileable, controllable SVBRDF generation (StyleGAN variant) + inverse rendering from a single photo. For repeating stage/env materials.

section_a_texture_material.name: Materialize
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (GPL-3.0). GPL -> QUARANTINE: do not embed in shipped tree. Useful as an offline authoring reference, not pipeline code.
section_a_texture_material.what: Free desktop app: converts a single photo into full PBR map set (albedo, normal, height, roughness, metallic, AO, edge/ambient maps).

section_a_texture_material.name: NormalMap Online
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT). Algorithm is portable to Python/JS in one afternoon — cheapest normal-map stage available, no GPU needed.
section_a_texture_material.what: In-browser normal/AO/displacement/roughness map generation from a height/diffuse image (Sobel-based, JS).

section_a_texture_material.name: Laigter
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (GPL-3.0). GPL -> QUARANTINE. 2D-sprite oriented; marginal value for 3D character pipeline.
section_a_texture_material.what: Sprite normal/specular map generator (Qt app) with preview.

section_a_texture_material.license: Freeware (proprietary); bundled license permits use/copy/redistribution incl. commercial
section_a_texture_material.name: xNormal
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: bundled license (quoted in official help docs) permits use, copy, redistribution for any purpose incl. commercial; no reverse-engineering. Windows-only binary — best fit as an offline bake workstation tool, not Linux pipeline code.
section_a_texture_material.what: Industry-standard high-poly to low-poly map baker (normal, AO, displacement, cavity, bent normals). Batch rendering supported.

section_a_texture_material.name: AwesomeBump
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (GPL-3.0). GPL -> QUARANTINE. NormalMap-Online (MIT) covers the same need commercially safe.
section_a_texture_material.what: Single-image to normal/roughness/AO/specular map generator (Qt/OpenGL).

section_a_texture_material.license: GPL-3.0 (original distribution; some forks claim XFree-style)
section_a_texture_material.name: InsaneBump
section_a_texture_material.notes: Original release GPLv3 (gist title confirms); fork READMEs claim ultra-permissive XFree-style. Treat as GPL -> QUARANTINE regardless. Requires GIMP; dated — skip in favor of MIT options.
section_a_texture_material.what: GIMP plugin generating normal/specular/AO/height maps from a single image.

section_a_texture_material.free_tier: Code open; weights free but gated (accept license on HF)
section_a_texture_material.license: Apache-2.0 (code); model weights = Stability AI Community License (gated)
section_a_texture_material.name: SDXL inpainting (diffusers)
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: diffusers Apache-2.0 via GitHub API. Weights are Community License (commercial OK with conditions). Directly targets speckle-noise/hole defects in generated textures.
section_a_texture_material.what: SDXL inpainting pipeline via diffusers: repair UV maps (fill holes, erase speckle artifacts, seam touch-up) with mask + prompt.

section_a_texture_material.name: IP-Adapter
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (Apache-2.0). Feeds owner's character references straight into texture diffusion — key for keeping generated textures on-model.
section_a_texture_material.what: Image-prompt adapter for SD/SDXL: condition texture generation on reference IMAGES (owner's art) instead of text alone — likeness lock.

section_a_texture_material.name: ControlNet
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via GitHub API (Apache-2.0). Depth-ControlNet on rendered views = texture regen that exactly follows geometry; complements MV-Adapter stage.
section_a_texture_material.what: Spatial conditioning (depth, normal, pose, canny) for diffusion — depth-locked re-texturing of generated views, pose-locked variants.

section_a_texture_material.license: Custom CC0 (commercial OK, NO attribution, NO redistribution)
section_a_texture_material.name: ShareTextures
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified 2026-08-24 live license page via third-party catalog audit: 'Custom CC0' — commercial use OK, but redistribution on other sites/plugins/collections is banned. Ship inside the game, never re-host the library.
section_a_texture_material.what: Free PBR texture sets (diffuse, normal, displacement, roughness, AO, specular) up to 4K, no signup.

section_a_texture_material.name: 3DTextures.me
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified as CC0 via third-party license audit (integrity-engine docs). Good stage/env material source for AshLane districts.
section_a_texture_material.what: Free seamless PBR sets (diffuse, normal, height, AO, roughness), Blender/UE/Unity oriented.

section_a_texture_material.license: Proprietary terms; commercial use included even on free tier
section_a_texture_material.name: Textures.com
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified via ToS Rev3-11 (free credits = limited selection/sizes) and pricing pages (Starter ~$11-14/mo). Manual download site — reference source, not automatable at scale.
section_a_texture_material.what: Large photo-texture library. Free tier: 15 credits/day (limited selection/smaller sizes); commercial license included on all tiers.

section_a_texture_material.free_tier: Free but non-commercial; site itself 404 as of 2026-08
section_a_texture_material.name: sIBL archive (HDRLabs)
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified: NC-SA license quoted on multiple mirrors; archive page HTTP 404 per 2026-08 audit. Non-commercial kills it for shipped games; keep as render-reference only.
section_a_texture_material.what: Smart-IBL HDRI sets (background + reflection + GI variants) for image-based lighting.

section_a_texture_material.name: NoEmotion HDRs
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified on noemotionhdrs.net footer: CC Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0. Commercial use allowed, but NoDerivatives + attribution burden — fine for lighting, not for redistribution.
section_a_texture_material.what: 150 free high-res HDRIs (day/evening/night), ~15K px, for IBL and backgrounds.

section_a_texture_material.license: Mixed: some free maps = commercial OK; most free 2K = Non-Commercial, Non-transferable; hi-res paid = royalty-free commercial
section_a_texture_material.name: HDRI Skies
section_a_texture_material.notes: Verified per-map license labels on hdri-skies.com (e.g. map 809 'Commercial Use'; maps 660/910+ 'Non-Commercial, Non-transferable'). Check EACH map's label before use.
section_a_texture_material.what: Sky HDRI maps; free 2K downloads, paid high-res (up to 30K) with backplates.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: Open3D
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: LICENSE file text is MIT (SPDX tag in file). Poisson recon = watertight meshes from generated point clouds/splats; fastest watertightness win in the catalog.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Point-cloud/mesh processing: Poisson surface reconstruction, mesh cleanup, simplification, ray casting. pip-installable.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: libigl
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: repo root contains LICENSE.MPL2 and LICENSE.GPL (dual). MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft — usable in proprietary pipelines if libigl files are kept separate. The Swiss-army knife for topology cleanup.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Header-only geometry processing library: remeshing, smoothing, decimation, parameterization, booleans, hole filling. Python bindings available.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: PyMesh
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Do NOT wire until the revival repo is located and its license confirmed. libigl/pmp cover the same ground with verified licenses.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Revived Python mesh-processing library (boolean, remesh, repair). Revival repo location UNCONFIRMED — PyMesh/PyMesh 404s; original qnzhou/PyMesh archived.

section_b_mesh_processing.free_tier: Open under GPL; commercial license paid
section_b_mesh_processing.name: CGAL
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: LICENSE.md documents the dual scheme (dist tarballs GPL-3.0+; git-only files CC0). GPL -> QUARANTINE for the shipped tree. Heavy C++ build; pmp/libigl cover 80% of the need.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Computational geometry: polygon mesh repair, hole filling, boolean ops, isotropic remeshing, alpha shapes.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: Manifold
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API (Apache-2.0). pip install manifold3d — the single best watertightness/boolean guarantee in the catalog; ideal post-generation repair stage.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Guaranteed-manifold triangle meshes: fast booleans, hull, offset, smooth — 'if the input is garbage, output is still manifold'. Python package manifold3d.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: ManifoldPlus
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: README states 'This software is distributed for free for non-commercial use only.' Research-only; prefer Manifold (Apache) or Open3D Poisson for commercial builds.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Triangle-soup to watertight manifold conversion preserving sharp features (SDF-free, plane-fitting approach).

section_b_mesh_processing.name: fast-simplification
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT, pyvista org). pip install fast-simplification — near-zero-effort decimation stage for mobile/web poly budgets.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Python quadric edge-collapse mesh decimation (pip package), preserves UVs — game-ready LODs from dense generated meshes.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: Geogram
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: LICENSE file is BSD 3-Clause (Inria). Solid remesh/boolean backend; C++ with some Python exposure.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Geometry processing: remeshing, CSG booleans, centroidal Voronoi, parameterization (used inside Blender-adjacent tooling).

section_b_mesh_processing.name: pmp-library
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT). Clean modern API; good hole-fill/smoothing stage for scan/AI-generated meshes.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Polygon Mesh Processing: smoothing, curvature, hole filling, remeshing, decimation, subdivision. Header-only C++.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: OpenVDB
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 (note: NOT MPL — older references say MPL 2.0, the current file is Apache). Volume-based repair route for badly broken generated meshes.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Sparse volumetric data: level-set repair -> watertight meshing from noisy/SDF inputs; NanoVDB for GPU.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: VCG / vcglib
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API (GPL-3.0). GPL -> QUARANTINE (MeshLab itself was already rejected for this reason). No unique capability vs MIT alternatives.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: MeshLab's core library: cleaning, smoothing, simplification, curvature, sampling.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: OptCuts
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT, LICENSE.txt). Best-in-class automatic UVs — better seams = better texture projection; direct upgrade path over xatlas for hero assets. C++ build, batchable.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Joint optimization of cuts + parameterization: auto UVs minimizing seam length under distortion bounds. Headless mode available.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: Boundary First Flattening
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API (MIT). Great for user-driven UV workflows (in-game generator UI); OptCuts wins for fully automatic quality.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Fast conformal UV flattening with interactive boundary control — near-interactive speed on million-tri meshes.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: PyMeshFix
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified via GitHub API LICENSE (GPL-3.0; PyPI classifiers agree). GPL -> QUARANTINE despite the easy pip install. Manifold (Apache) is the commercial-safe replacement.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Python/Cython wrapper of MeshFix: fills holes, removes self-intersections/degenerate elements -> single watertight mesh.

section_b_mesh_processing.name: RizomUV
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified on rizomuv.com plans page: perpetual EUR149.90, node-locked EUR34.90/mo, rent-to-own EUR14.90/mo. No budget -> deprioritize; OptCuts/BFF are the free answers.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: Industry-standard standalone UV unwrapping (auto seams, packing, UDIM). Bridge addons for Blender exist.

section_b_mesh_processing.free_tier: Free SDK Standard edition (any purpose incl. commercial); full engine ~$29+
section_b_mesh_processing.license: Proprietary — PAID (addon GPL, engine EULA); SDK Standard free for any purpose
section_b_mesh_processing.name: UVPackmaster
section_b_mesh_processing.notes: Verified: 80.lv + Blender Market — SDK Standard usable free for any purpose. Packing-only (needs UVs from elsewhere); nice-to-have, not a gap-closer.
section_b_mesh_processing.what: GPU/CPU-accelerated UV island packing engine (Blender addon + standalone SDK).

top_8_picks.name: SyncMVD
top_8_picks.rationale: MIT, diffusers-native, seam-free synchronized multi-view texturing — directly closes the #1 texture gap (multi-view inconsistency/fragmentation) and drops into the existing Hunyuan3D-Paint/MV-Adapter stack.

top_8_picks.name: Paint3D
top_8_picks.rationale: Apache-2.0 CVPR24, lighting-less 2K UV textures — kills baked-lighting speckle, the core Tripo texture-quality gap; output is relightable in PBR pipeline.

top_8_picks.name: Manifold
top_8_picks.rationale: Apache-2.0, pip-installable, guaranteed-manifold booleans/repair — the cheapest, safest watertightness stage; difficulty 2.

top_8_picks.name: TEXTure
top_8_picks.rationale: MIT text-guided texture gen/EDIT/refine/transfer — the only candidate enabling owner-driven texture tweaks without full regeneration.

top_8_picks.name: OptCuts
top_8_picks.rationale: MIT, joint seam+distortion UV optimization — best automatic UVs in the catalog; better UVs multiply every texture stage's quality. Headless mode = batchable.

top_8_picks.name: Open3D
top_8_picks.rationale: MIT, pip install, Poisson reconstruction + cleanup — second watertightness route plus the mesh-processing utilities the pipeline will reuse everywhere.

top_8_picks.name: SwinIR
top_8_picks.rationale: Apache-2.0, CPU-capable texture SR/denoise — near-zero-effort crispness win complementing Real-ESRGAN; difficulty 2.

top_8_picks.name: fast-simplification
top_8_picks.rationale: MIT pip package, quadric decimation preserving UVs — difficulty 1 wire-up for game-ready poly budgets on every generated asset.
